rationale: Setup is always limited at ss 100C 1.60V max-RC; hold, slew/cap (0 vs bar 295) and DRC are non-issues. AREA 3 produced all five best runs; DELAY/AREA 2 were worse. Loose targets let port paths dominate and inflate T_eff uncertainty, so pin the tightest target (0.45 = 8.59 ns) for r2r-limited, re-run-honest scores. Stock RC under-predicted wire delay (aes missed by 1.4 ns); cap213 tracked signoff (des landed near its margin) and was used by the two best runs. Timing-driven placement, post-GRT timing repair and moderate margins should keep the later re-run at T_eff passing. Util 40 gave the shortest wirelength and best T_eff. Leave buffering, sizing, density and repair knobs to TPE.
